description: Record uninterrupted G2 audio (16 kHz s16le mono via audioControl) for 60 minutes on reference flagship Android devices (Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 / Dimensity 9500 / Tensor G5 class) and iPhones (A18 Pro/A19 class, iOS 26+). Lock and background the phone; document actual behavior (WebView reclaim, capture drops, gaps). iOS suspends backgrounded web content more aggressively. plan.md §3, §13.1.
title: Spike: 60-minute G2 audio capture with lock/background
